title: AI向科学推理与网络安全纵深推进，欧洲AI投资占比首超50%
core_insight: AI系统正从通用能力向专业科学推理和网络安全等垂直领域深度渗透，同时欧洲AI投资首次占据风险投资主导地位

dimension_texts.technology: AI系统在科学推理和具身推理能力上持续深化，LABBench2为生物学研究AI系统提供改进基准，OOWM通过面向对象编程式世界建模增强具身推理的结构化表示 Belief-State RWKV将循环状态明确解释为信念状态而非不透明隐藏向量，为部分可观测环境下的强化学习提供新框架 LABBench2: An Improved Benchmark for AI Systems Performing Biology Research OOWM: Structuring Embodied Reasoning and Planning via Object-Oriented Programmatic World Modeling Belief-State RWKV for Reinforcement Learning under Partial Observability
dimension_texts.infrastructure: 今日无显著变化，虽有Efficient Matrix Implementation for Rotary Position Embedding等技术优化，但未涉及重大成本突破 今日无显著变化，无新硬件发布或云厂商定价调整相关信号
dimension_texts.application: AI向网络安全防御深度渗透，OpenAI推出GPT-5.4-Cyber专门面向网络安全专家；Google将AI Skills集成到Chrome浏览器，实现工作流保存和重用 OpenFlo通过模拟用户行为进行自动化UX评估，可能替代传统人工用户体验测试；AI SRE工具包opensre推动运维自动化 Trusted access for the next era of cyber defense Google adds AI Skills to Chrome to help you save favorite workflows OpeFlo: Automated UX Evaluation via Simulated Human Web Interaction with GUI Grounding
dimension_texts.capital: 欧洲AI投资出现结构性转变，Q1 2026年AI首次占据欧洲风险投资50%以上份额，总额达17.6亿美元 欧洲风险投资连续第二个季度增长，年同比增长近30%，但交易量大幅下降，显示资金向头部AI项目集中 OpenAI收购AI个人理财初创公司Hiro，表明其正将财务规划能力整合到ChatGPT中；Anthropic与政府保持接触同时进行法律诉讼的复杂策略 AI Drives Europe's Second Straight Quarter Of Funding Gain As Deal Volume Falls Sharply OpenAI has bought AI personal finance startup Hiro Anthropic co-founder confirms the company briefed the Trump administration on Mythos
dimension_texts.risk: Anthropic与特朗普政府的接触显示AI公司与监管机构的复杂关系，同时存在法律诉讼，表明监管环境不确定性 多篇论文关注AI安全对齐问题，如Deliberative Alignment研究推理模型的安全性改进，Human vs. Machine Deception研究AI生成虚假内容检测 今日无显著地缘风险信号 Anthropic co-founder confirms the company briefed the Trump administration on Mythos Deliberative Alignment is Deep, but Uncertainty Remains: Inference time safety improvement in reasoning via attribution of unsafe behavior to base model Human vs. Machine Deception: Distinguishing AI-Generated and Human-Written Fake News Using Ensemble Learning
